subject.title: Ollama local provider: native tool_calls not recognized, falls back to unreliable JSON-text parsing

question: Should this issue stay in live-repro/manual-review until the active Ollama API, base URL, tool list, and raw response are captured, or is the current report enough to queue a native stream fix?
rationale: Current source and the latest release already support native Ollama `tool_calls`, while the report includes signals consistent with `/v1` compatibility routing or missing MCP tool exposure, so automation cannot safely choose a code fix without proof of where the structured call is lost.

options.title: Require live config and raw-response proof
options.body: Keep the issue open for a maintainer or contributor to capture the resolved provider config, OpenClaw payload, Ollama response, and registered tool names before deciding on a code fix.

options.title: Queue a native stream repair now
options.body: Treat the report as a confirmed native Ollama stream bug and risk building a speculative fix against a path that source already appears to cover.

options.title: Close as unsupported /v1 usage
options.body: Close only if the reporter confirms the active runtime was OpenAI-compatible `/v1` routing rather than native `api: "ollama"`.

recommendation.title: Require live config and raw-response proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for a maintainer or contributor to capture the resolved provider config, OpenClaw payload, Ollama response, and registered tool names before deciding on a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the prior merged native Ollama tool-call replay hardening and is the best available history owner for deciding the proof threshold.
